events.title: QUEERHUB Film Festival: Friday
events.description: Across the two nights, the programme combines shared screenings with a different curated film block each evening, followed by a filmmaker Q&A. After the screenings, the evening opens up into a more relaxed space for conversation, with snacks, filmmakers, guests and the wider QUEERHUB community coming together beyond the screen.

events.title: Knitflix Club: Love Actually
events.description: Bring your yarn, grab a drink, and knit or crochet alongside this Christmas classic at our lights-on cinema event! We'll keep the cinema room lit during the screening so you can work on your project alongside the film. There is a bar available at the venue. You may arrive up to 30mins early to grab a drink and meet other stitchers and compare WIPs before the film starts. This is a relaxed atmosphere, so people are welcome to chat with neighbours and compare notes on Colin Firth! All crafts and skill levels welcome.
events.notes: Lights-on screening for knitting and crochet
